description: The Backport configuration for the **kibana** project, owned by **elastic**, points to the upstream repository `elastic/kibana`. Available target branches are **7.10**, **7.11** and **7.12**, with **7.11** pre‑selected for backporting while **7.12** remains unselected. The same set of branches—**7.10**, **7.11** (checked), and **7.12** (unchecked)—defines the actual branches the tool will backport to. Pull‑requests created by this configuration will automatically receive the labels **backport** and **auto-merged**, and the view will include commits from any contributor (the “all” option is set to false).
